status: Architecture and target-input specification; no selected parent sequence, assembled prediction or experimental activity.
objective: Increase MERTK-dependent internalization of apoptotic cells with useful receptor retention and repeated uptake.
parent_selection: Independent backbone passing native glycan/accessibility checks, orthogonal structure assessment, expression and native-cell binding.
scaffold: Initially Fc-free tandem display; use two copies of the same qualified MERTK parent for the dimerization comparison.

cargo_module.candidate: Human annexin A5 as an existing project PS-recognition starting point; module choice is not yet validated for this fusion.
required_evidence: No loss of uptake from PS masking

formats.purpose: Parent binding, ligand competition and shedding reference
Test engagement of two separate MERTK molecules
Test cargo recruitment with one receptor-binding arm
Lead architecture hypothesis combining receptor pairing and apoptotic-cell recruitment
Screen qualified Ig1/Ig2 parents for shedding protection; prioritize receptor retention over forced crosslinking
Compare Ig1-Ig2 tandem occupancy of one receptor versus bridging two receptors; no dimerization claim from valency alone.

assembly_requirements: Choose linker length, rigidity and order from actual terminal exit directions of qualified bound parents; no fixed linker is yet justified.
Require a sterically possible complex with two distinct membrane-anchored MERTK molecules and PS-bearing cargo.
Retain all receptor domains and glycans as context even though binder epitopes are limited to Ig1/Ig2.
An Ig1-Ig2 tandem may occupy one receptor; do not count its two binding domains as proof of receptor dimerization.
Model confidence and predicted stoichiometry do not establish activation or increased efferocytosis.

protector.binding_scope: Ig1/Ig2 only; direct FNIIIb/stalk binder design is retired.
protector.hypothesis: Distal occupancy may alter cleavage accessibility or receptor conformation; no protective Ig epitope is established.
required_readouts: Preserved intact surface and total MERTK
Preserved GAS6 and PROS1 function tested separately
Improved internalized apoptotic-cell uptake under shedding stress
confound_controls: Independent detection epitopes and soluble-protein assay interference
protector.integration_rule: Combine a proven protector with the active bridge only after each mechanism is measured separately; recheck the complete fusion.

controls: MERTK loss or validated pathway blockade with orthogonal control
endpoint: Donor-paired internalized apoptotic-cell cargo per viable macrophage, with repeated uptake and receptor retention; distinguish adhesion from internalization.
blockers: No experimentally justified active receptor geometry
Experimental glycan guard requires GPU integration preflight and output review
role: Functional format panel downstream of Aim 1, with P1 as the separate Aim 2 screening format
